why: the raw mirror needs headroom for source + edge shards + sort spills + canonical outputs coexisting. 46 GB free was too tight for a 31.3 GB source.

STANDING_RULE_OVERRIDE.the_rule: supersede-don't-delete: move superseded artifacts into a clearly named subdirectory rather than removing them.
STANDING_RULE_OVERRIDE.overridden_by: the user, explicitly, for extraction products and temporary repair products.
STANDING_RULE_OVERRIDE.why_it_is_sound_here: these files are a cache, not history. Every one is re-derivable from idirlab-freebases.zip, which is retained and whose bytes and MD5 match Zenodo exactly. Deleting a verified-regenerable cache loses no record. Nothing that constitutes evidence -- no measurement, no check record, no hash -- is touched.

what_was_NOT_deleted.idirlab-freebases.zip: provenance anchor AND the compressed store every deletion here is reversible from. Never delete.
what_was_NOT_deleted.recovered_offsets.json: the repair key. Without it re-extraction costs an 81-second signature scan of 14 GB; with it, nothing.
what_was_NOT_deleted.oracle/*.parquet: IDIR's frozen role, in the form that role actually needs.
what_was_NOT_deleted.Metadata/{properties,types,domains}_id_l: under 1 MB total; the TypeSystem keys
what_was_NOT_deleted.*/relation2id.txt: all four variants, under 1 MB total; the reverse-split evidence

REGENERATION.how: python scratchpad/final_canonical_build/webqsp_v1/v3_extract_true_size.py with the WRITE list set to the wanted entries. It reads recovered_offsets.json, inflates each stream to its own deflate EOF and CRC-verifies against the central directory.
REGENERATION.cost: object_types.csv 66s; the FB+CVT+REV set about 62s; everything else faster.
REGENERATION.caveat: the distillation logged small unparsed residues -- 794 lines of entities_id_label.csv and 677 of object_names.csv, 0 of object_types.csv, out of 386M lines total. If those ever need inspecting, re-extract; the Parquet does not contain them.

elapsed_note: oracle distillation took 1138s and is recorded in V3_ORACLE_DISTILLATION.json.
